_comment: Reconstructed from ladder-20260615-081058.log blunder turns. Levels approximate (~randbats); our-side abilities/items left 0 (neutral for the move-ranking diagnostic). Opp ability/item/bench are determinized by RandomBattle from real randbats sets. our_boosts index order = [Atk,Def,SpA,SpD,Spe,Acc,Eva]. blunder/better_action are move-slot bytes (0-3). | T0-00-Exp1 added 6 missed-KO fixtures (+bench) reconstructed from showdown-bridge/logs/ladder-20260615-081058.log; our & opp EVs 85x6, IV 31, neutral nature/ability/item, levels~randbats. G0 status is recorded per-case in note. VALID: t53/t7/t17/t5; INVALID (no KO asymmetry): t6, t15. | THEME-04-G1 substrate (analytic-root lever): 5 NEW fixtures (+bench) authored by raising opp HP into the better move's marginal band (Type-M/MT) and via a last_mon flag. last_mon=true is consumed ONLY by blunder_probe's LastMonRandomBattle wrapper (faints the determinized opp bench so a root KO empties the opp team -> terminal winner_value; RandomBattle always fills the bench to 6, so the fixture cannot encode last-mon alone). G0 ALL VALID full-conf (better k in [1,15] marginal or 16; blunder k=0; marginal verdict stable across +-2 opp level; crit k_crit=16 -> G2 two-grid). Open-loop @seeds{177,178,179} PROBE_WORLDS=8 PROBE_MS=4000: Type-M marginal-dachsbun flips 6/6 (bare+bench), marginal-armarouge bare 3/3 / bench 0/3; Type-MT mt-armarouge(damaging blunder) flips 6/6 strongly (KO avg~0.78 terminal), mt-necrozma(boost blunder Calm Mind) bare REPRODUCES blunder 3/3 (KO Photon Geyser under-priced avg~0.21 vs Calm Mind boost-eval 0.62) -> the GOLD analytic-flip target; Type-T lastmon-necrozma(16/16 terminal) KO avg 0.79-0.99 ~winner_value, picked 5/6. Terminality verified: same 16/16 KO move avg 0.16/0.45 (non-terminal existing t5) -> 0.80/0.98 (last_mon terminal).

cases.name: g04-t25-manaphy-capped-tailglow
cases.note: Manaphy already +6 SpA (Tail Glow used t4/t21/t23) keeps using Tail Glow (a no-op at +6) vs Ursaring 33%, instead of Ice Beam/Hydro Pump which KO. blunder=Tail Glow(no-op), better=Ice Beam.

cases.name: g04-CONTROL-manaphy-NO-boost
cases.note: CONTROL for state-fidelity hypothesis: same Manaphy/Ursaring position but with NO SpA boost in the state (boosts=0). If Tail Glow now clears the filter / is picked, the live blunder is explained by the +6 boost being ABSENT from the live search state, not by eval/pick.

cases.name: g16-t20-granbull-twave-into-par
cases.note: Granbull uses Thunder Wave into Slowbro that is ALREADY paralyzed (opp belief shows 'slowbro 69% par'), a guaranteed no-op, instead of Play Rough/Earthquake which deal damage. blunder=Thunder Wave(no-op), better=Play Rough.

cases.name: g16-t20-granbull-twave-WITH-BENCH
cases.note: Same Granbull-into-paralyzed-Slowbro turn but with our real game-16 bench (Kilowattrel, Klawf) so it is not an artificial 1-vs-6. Robustness check for the visit-vs-value pathology.
